race.comment: VIVALDA (7) just missed here on resumption from a wide draw when coursing wide, missing by 0.3L. The rise in trip should suit, though she's drawn out again which is the query. She rates highly off the fresh run though and with a touch of luck early, she can go one better. OUR ENCHANTRESS (10) got back and never featured last start after a good run the start prior. Gets some weight relief with the 4kg claimer on board and if she jumps with them this time, she can shed the maiden tag. GOLD LILLY (8) is a 10-start maiden who finished fifth at her most recent outing over 1621m at this track. Expected to feature in the finish this time. MISS BICKMORE (12) hasn't been far away her past couple and can be in the finish again. JOYHOUSE ROCK (11) raced on pace for much of the way before fading in the straight over 1100m here last time. Third-up now and can improve.
